items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: And his sister said to me, say, Bernice?

ctx.x: Which Happy was that? Little Happy. The one that's alive now? Uh-huh. He was on the taxi call. Plays with the Eureka bands. Yeah, I don't know where Happy lived, but I knew it was him.

Not red Happy? Uh-uh. Not red. A dark one. Yeah, there's two of the Happys that always get to- No, I don't mean red. I mean the dark one. So Happy carried him as he knows? Uh-huh. Well, I'll be. That must have been a big one. It was a funeral, I'm telling you. Everybody talked about that funeral. How many bands did that have? I think they had two or three if I'm mistaken. Because it happened so quick. I just left the boy the day before. He played a funeral out, St. Mary, and Chippewa. And he said, we got another…
She said, little Henry. I said, what? She said, he just died there.
